predictions.text: I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will see at least two more naval engagements involving ships from the United States and Iran.
I predict that the Reserve Bank of Australia will raise interest rates again before the end of November 2026, possibly by another 0.25 percentage points, in response to ongoing inflation pressures.

I predict that the new laws in Singapore will be enforced with arrests and fines against companies or individuals responsible for contributing to the haze, with at least one significant case involving an Indonesian company by the end of Thursday, 12 November 2026.
I predict that communal conflicts in Zamfara State will continue, with at least one more attack on a security convoy involving the Nigerian military or a local protection force.
I predict that India will win the 2026 Men's Asian Champions Trophy.

grade.line: India beat Japan 4–1 in the final on 5 November to win their third title in a row.
